verdict.rationale: Temporal explicitly markets AI-workflow orchestration and ships integrations with Google ADK and the Vercel AI SDK, both of which support LLM steps with model selection and tool use inside Temporal Activities/Workflows, but the evidence lacks concrete detail on how model choice or tool invocation is configured within a Temporal workflow. missing for 10: explicit code examples or docs showing model selection, tool-calling configuration, or a dedicated AI-agent primitive, and independent/hands-on confirmation of these integrations working end-to-end.
